Who We Are

About AgriSense AI

AgriSense AI is an AI-powered agricultural platform built specifically for Nigerian farmers. Founded in 2026, our mission is to democratise access to cutting-edge agricultural technology for every farmer — regardless of location, language, or technical ability.

We combine computer vision, natural language processing, and local market data to deliver a comprehensive farming assistant that works on low-end smartphones and in low-connectivity environments.

6+ Languages
Works on 2G / 3G
30+ Partners
12,400+ Farmers

Privacy Policy

At AgriSense AI, we take your privacy seriously. We collect minimal data needed to provide our services — primarily your name, email, location, and crop images you upload for disease detection. We never share your data with third parties without your explicit consent. Your crop images are used only for analysis and are not stored permanently unless you opt in. Read our full policy for details on data handling, storage, and your rights.
